title: Sigma Lithium Q1 2026 management discussion and analysis
excerpt: At March 31, 2026 Sigma reported USD 3.9 million cash, USD 133.9 million short- and long-term debt, USD 144.527 million negative working capital, and material weaknesses in internal control; Q1 operating cash use was USD 2.7 million.
summary: The SEC-hosted Q1 MD&A provides current financial, operating, liquidity, going-concern, receivables, debt, and internal-control evidence for the security assessment.
